move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.
Thank you for the long and reliable partnership; your quality has long been our benchmark for fasteners. We would now like to bring the complete fastener kit to one partner, including the larger bolt you do not supply to us today, and we see you as the natural choice. In return we can commit the full kit volume as binding for the contract period. Our proposal below keeps prices stable and gives your second shift steady, plannable work.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).
Our latest orders for this part were all at EUR 12.78 per 1000 units (po:4500014466-20, po:4500014395-10, po:4500014328-20).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Likewise, we checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

We highly value your intention to consolidate the complete fastener kit with us and welcome the 24-month volume commitment. To support this strategic step, we have applied a discount reflecting the verified increase in your volume forecast. 

Our main proposal features a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.51 per unit, a contract term of 24 months. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms, and our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

key_points: Routine bundling case: one supplier, single sheet focus; fallback is current terms at the current kit price, so any deal must beat it on total cost.
Leitner has idle capacity and wants volume; the kit (incl. the M16 bolt it does not supply today) is our main trade good. Commit the kit volume as binding inside our fixed need.
Lead with checkable forecast rises (volume_change) and flat order history; keep washer rival price only for the washer.
Never cite Mairhofer bolt/nut prices, index peaks, market news, dependency or health facts.
Offer 24 months (fixed per contract today) and test longer payment cheaply; it has no cash need, so payment terms may come free.
Keep asks moderate so the account manager can close without the pricing committee; step in shrinking real moves, accept a final offer.
plan.stance_why: Routine goal and a sound, low-dependency supplier that is already cheapest on bolt and nut; the kit adds the dearer M16 bolt where real room exists, so a moderate anchor with volume and length is right, not a hard squeeze.

levers.why: Checkable; the M16 bolt is new business for it and growing, the core of the bundle value.

argument.sentence: Our demand forecast for this part has risen 15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).
argument.note: Snapshot 2026-09: 208400 for the next 12 months against 180800 ordered in the last 12 months (requested dates); shared with suppliers: True. More volume is worth more to it.

levers.why: Checkable washer price anchor; sets up washer step without revealing bolt/nut rival gaps.

argument.sentence: Our latest orders for this part were all at EUR 12.78 per 1000 units (po:4500014466-20, po:4500014395-10, po:4500014328-20).
argument.note: What we pay now: [12.78, 12.78, 12.78] per 1000 units (2026-08-25 to 2026-09-28); anchors any increase.

levers.why: Context that stability has been the shared renewal outcome; frames a hold as normal.

argument.note: 3 renewals: asked +2.7% on average, settled +0.0% (gap 2.7 pp); last 2025-12-06: asked +3.6%, settled +0.0%. It usually settles well below its ask.

levers.why: Fresh checkable volume fact for round two.

argument.sentence: Our demand forecast for this part has risen 9.0% (fc:360012@2026-09).
argument.note: Snapshot 2026-09: 654000 for the next 12 months against 600000 ordered in the last 12 months (requested dates); shared with suppliers: True. More volume is worth more to it.

levers.why: Fresh volume fact on the washer.

argument.sentence: Our demand forecast for this part has risen 8.7% (fc:360030@2026-09).
argument.note: Snapshot 2026-09: 736000 for the next 12 months against 677200 ordered in the last 12 months (requested dates); shared with suppliers: True. More volume is worth more to it.

levers.why: Washer only: second source buys slightly cheaper; justifies small washer step.

argument.note: We also buy this part from sup:70630 at EUR 12.64 per 1000 units (order of 2026-09-28); -1.1% against its own price. Its order lines are citable as order history (same part); citing them reveals the rival's price.

levers.why: Another fresh volume record to keep movement.

argument.sentence: Our demand forecast for this part has risen 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
argument.note: Snapshot 2026-09: 574000 for the next 12 months against 541400 ordered in the last 12 months (requested dates); shared with suppliers: True. More volume is worth more to it.

levers.why: Late filler; trade against price rather than demand both.

argument.sentence: Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).
argument.note: Rolling 12 months to 2026-09-30: 88.6% on time against the requested date (88.6% against its own confirmed date); target 95%; peers' median 84.6%; class A green. A year earlier 86.4%.

levers.why: Shows we are a reliable payer if it questions longer terms.

argument.note: 235 invoices; we pay 2.1 days after due on average (last 12 months), 74.9% late, 0.0% over 10 days late, max 9; discounts taken 0 (0 after the period); short-paid 0. We pay reliably: a fair customer.

trades.why: Current contract already runs two years; offer it explicitly as planning security for its restarted shift.
No cash need; distributors often grant our standard term free, saving interest versus today's terms.
Fallback to today's term as a last-step give if it prices longer payment.

sup:70610.opening_paragraph: Thank you for the long and reliable partnership; your quality has long been our benchmark for fasteners. We would now like to bring the complete fastener kit to one partner, including the larger bolt you do not supply to us today, and we see you as the natural choice. In return we can commit the full kit volume as binding for the contract period. Our proposal below keeps prices stable and gives your second shift steady, plannable work.
watch_for: Requests for a catch-up increase citing labour, fastener index or steel: acknowledge, offer volume and length instead.
Signals of committee routing; keep steps small and allow its cycle.
A declared final offer: accept or take its cheaper alternative sheet.
Whether it prices longer payment; drop it if it costs price.
Pushback on delivery reliability on the M12 bolt; do not stack it with a price demand.

risks: Evidence on cost is thin (no should-cost); room on bolt and nut may be near zero.
Squeezing a financially sound, low-dependency supplier may make it walk; fallback is only today's terms.
M16 bolt pricing is unknown from this supplier; it may quote high on new business.
Citing any bolt or nut rival figure would invite an increase.
Committee cycles could stretch rounds; silence hardens offers into finals.
